seo.title: Cookies | Hotel Zagi
seo.description: Information about cookies on the Hotel Zagi website: which cookies we use, why, and how you can control them in your browser settings.

sections.heading: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. They may be necessary for the site to work, or used for analytics, advertising and third-party services.

sections.heading: Which cookies we use
paragraphs: This website currently sets no tracking, analytics or advertising cookies. Your browser may store only technical settings locally (such as your cookie choice).
When you open the booking page, the WebBookingPro system may set its own cookies that are necessary for booking.

sections.heading: Future services
paragraphs: If we introduce services that require cookies (such as a virtual assistant or analytics), we will ask for your consent before loading them and list each cookie, its purpose and duration here.

sections.heading: How to control cookies
paragraphs: You can view and delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies may affect the booking system.
